evidence: The presence of possible contaminants (i.e. carbon) was investigated using X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) on all samples deposited on Si(100). Grazing incidence X-ray diffraction (GIXRD) showed that all samples were crystalline. The morphology of the samples was analyzed using high-resolution SEM (LEO 1550). The phase content was determined by GIXRD (Philips X’pert X-ray diffractometer) using Cu K a radiation. The carbon residue in the deposited films and other possible contaminants as well as the oxidation state of iron were investigated using XPS (Perkin-Elmer PHI 5500 multi-technique system).
